answer: Resist sybils with a jetty checkpoint and a wander. Each identity must wander a walk through peers each epoch, collecting one single-use whisper per step, and end at the jetty, which verifies the path before unlocking influence. A whisper can endorse only one path per epoch, so N clones need N times the endorsements, and honest peers are soon exhausted. If paths collide on a whisper, the jetty burns every bond on the colliding paths, multiplied by the collision size: m clones lose about m squared bonds. One honest agent pays one walk; a clone army pays N walks or faces quadratic ruin.
